description: VITALS connects a user's VITALS account to ChatGPT so the assistant can read their profile, collaboration directives, career profile, relationship reads, profile comparisons, and VITALS 360 feedback when those features are available. The app is read-only: it does not modify VITALS data, send messages, or take external actions.
